Class RcxRemoteControl

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxRemoteControl
public final class RcxRemoteControl extends Object
A receive-only LEGO Mindstorms RCX remote control, such as the 9738 handset.

Create it once at startup with the HX-M121 or Grove infrared receiver that hears the handset. The object configures the receiver at the RCX remote's 2400 baud and allocates its four-byte frame buffer during construction; polling with buttons() is allocation-free. The receiver must be pointed at the handset, which sends opcode 0xD2 with a 16-bit button mask. Call start() when the main loop also does work that must not be delayed by infrared decoding; the virtual receiver thread then puts button transitions into a fixed-size queue.

The last non-zero button mask is retained for 300 milliseconds when a repeat frame is missed, then reported as released. A release frame from the handset reports zero immediately. A frame whose opcode toggle bit differs from the previous frame's is a new transmission, so pressing the same button again queues it again. Calls to buttons() block briefly while a frame is decoded; start() moves those calls to a virtual receiver thread, which waits inside the native byte reader so it sees the start bit of each frame's first byte.
